Present Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anil Kumar Choudhary By the Court:- Heard the parties.

2.  This criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 439(2) of CrPC with a prayer for cancelling the order dated 19.08.2021 passed in ABP No.
740 of 2021 by learned Sessions Judge, East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur by which, anticipatory bail has been granted to the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 in connection with Bistupur P.S. Case no. 151 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. No. 1615 of 2021 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 323,
498A, 504, 34 of the IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned JMFC, Jamshedpur and further to direct the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 to surrender before learned court below.
3.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the daughter-in-law of the opp.
party nos. 2 and 3 and the marriage of petitioner was solemnized with the accused son of the opp.
party no. 2 and 3 on 26.11.2014 and after that, they have been blessed with a child of four years.
The accused son of the opp. party no. 2 and 3 filed Divorce Petition vide O.S. Case no. 632 of 2021 after institution of Bistupur P.S. Case no. 151 of 2021.

The police after investigation of the case, submitted charge sheet against the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 for having committed the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A, 504, 34 of the IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

sentences.text: 1 nos. 2 and 3 filed Anticipatory Bail Application no. 740 of 2021 before learned Sessions Judge, East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur.
Learned Sessions Judge, East Singhbhum at Jamshedpur allowed the anticipatory bail application.
Henceforth, the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 are threatening the petitioner and her father to withdraw the concerned case otherwise, she will face the dire consequence.
The father of the petitioner lodged complaint before the Officer- in-charge, Argora, Ranchi on 17.11.2021 hence, it is submitted that the bail granted to the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 be cancelled.

4. Learned Special PP and learned counsel for the opp. party no. 2 on the other hand vehemently opposes the prayer of the petitioner and submits that absolutely no reason has been advanced by the petitioner in this case to set aside the order passed by learned Sessions Judge and in the absence of any illegality or any impropriety in the order passed by learned Sessions Judge, East Singhbhum in Anticipatory Bail Application no. 740 of 2021 and as it being a settled principle of law that bail granted cannot be cancelled only on the bald allegation that the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 are threatening the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 submits that even going by own documents of the petitioner, there is no allegation against the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 that the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 themselves have done any acts, deeds or things and as there is only bald allegation against the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 and the complaint did not reveal the commission of any cognizable offence, hence, no action obviously has been taken by the police.
It is lastly submitted that this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit be dismissed.

5. Having heard the submissions made at the Bar and after carefully going through the materials available in the record, though in the body of the petition, it has been mentioned that the Anticipatory Bail granted to the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 be cancelled but the prayer portion shows that the prayer has been made to quash the order dated 19.08.2021 passed in ABP No. 740 of 2021.

It is pertinent to mention here that it is a settled principle of law that an order of anticipatory bail passed by a court can be set aside by the superior court if there is any illegality in the same or the same has been passed on the basis of any extraneous consideration or if such order of anticipatory bail is not in accordance with law.

6. Now coming to the facts of the case, there is no allegation as to what illegality has been committed by learned Sessions Judge, East Singhbhum in passing the order dated 19.08.2021 passed in ABP No. 740 of 2021.

So far as the allegation that the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 are threatening the petitioner and his father is concerned, the supporting documents do not show that the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 have committed any act, deed or thing, to deter the petitioner or her father and the only allegation is that some persons claiming to be the sent by the opp. party nos. 2 and 3, asked the father of the petitioner to tell the petitioner to withdraw the case.

This Court is of the considered view that the allegation made in the information submitted by the father of the petitioner to the officer-in-charge of Argora Police Station, do not even reveal the commission of a cognizable offence, hence, no action has been taken by the police in respect of the same.

In absence of any material to suggest that the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 themselves were involved in committing any of the acts, deeds or things such as :
(i) by indulging in similar criminal activity,

2 (ii) interfering with the course of investigation,
(iii) attempted to tamper with evidence or witnesses,
(iv) threaten witnesses or indulges in similar activities which would hamper smooth investigation,
(v) there is likelihood of the opp. party nos. 2 and 3 of fleeing to another country,
(vi) attempted to make himself scarce by going underground or becoming unavailable to the investigating agency,
(vii) attempted to place himself beyond the reach of his surety, etc.

7. Hence, this Court is of the considered view that there is no justifiable reason to cancel the bail granted to the opp. party nos. 2 and 3, accordingly, this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit is dismissed.
